Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
v1.0.0: Pre-Prisma/Clerk Migration - Firebase/Firestore Implementation

## Summary
Initial version of Litplan iOS app with Firebase/Firestore backend.
This commit marks the state before migrating to Prisma + Clerk.

## Features Included
- iOS App \(SwiftUI, iOS 17+\)
  - Home/Explore view with city card stacks
  - Search view for city lookup
  - Viewed Cities tab
  - Profile view
  - Component library \(buttons, cards, states\)

- Backend \(Firebase Cloud Functions + TypeScript\)
  - Firestore data models \(User, City, Plan, GroupFlow\)
  - Authentication with Sign in with Apple
  - Subscription management with StoreKit 2
  - All API endpoints implemented
  - Weekly AI plan refresh scheduled function

- AI Team Workflow
  - Complete .ai-team coordination folder
  - Sprint plans and daily logs
  - QA reports and checklists

## Tech Stack
- Database: Cloud Firestore
- Auth: Sign in with Apple / iCloud
- Payments: StoreKit 2
- Backend: Firebase Cloud Functions
- iOS: SwiftUI, iOS 17+

## Next Version
v2.0.0 will migrate to:
- Database: Prisma + PostgreSQL / PlanetScale
- Auth: Clerk \(Google, Apple, Email/Password\)

EOF

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
workflow: Add mandatory git branching workflow for all agents

MAJOR WORKFLOW UPDATE: All agents must now use feature branches

Changes:
- ios-agentic-workflow.md: Added comprehensive git branching section
  - Mandatory branch creation at start of work
  - Commit guidelines during work
  - Push requirements at end of work
  - PM end-of-day merge process
  - Daily git checklist for agents and PM
  - Conflict resolution guide

- Updated all agent context files with git requirements:
  - BACKEND_ENGINEER_CONTEXT.md: backend/[feature]-[date] branches
  - UI_DESIGNER_CONTEXT.md: ui/[feature]-[date] branches
  - QA_TESTER_CONTEXT.md: qa/[feature]-[date] branches

Process:
1. Agents create feature branches at start of work
2. Agents commit frequently with descriptive messages
3. Agents push branches at end of work
4. PM reviews all branches
5. PM merges approved work into main
6. PM pushes to remote and tags milestones

This ensures:
- No direct commits to main
- Code review before merge
- Clear audit trail
- Easy rollback if needed

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
